formatPolicy: Keep original TTF/OTF as source only when license permits.
No font binary is runtime-approved until intake, license review, and render testing pass.
cssPolicy: Use CSS variables for semantic roles.
Preload only the minimum Academy identity/body/mono faces after performance review.
phaserPolicy: DOM HUD can use CSS fonts directly.
Phaser Text can use loaded web fonts after font loading gate.
BitmapText requires a separate bitmap font generation lane and is not assumed.
comparisonSetPolicy: Slash-separated font groups are planning comparison sets, not single ingest units.
Future visual evaluation, licensing, provenance, and binary intake must occur per individual font family, style, and weight.
H5.96 does not approve any grouped font candidate for bundled runtime use.

renderingModePolicy.codeNative: Use for dynamic text, accessibility, layout, modal behavior, dense data, input controls, and debug truth surfaces.
renderingModePolicy.assetBacked: Use for decorative frames, icons, stable panels, and approved visual skins only after mapping/review.
renderingModePolicy.hybrid: Preferred for fantasy UI: asset/frame/backplate provides affordance, code renders text/data/icons into validated slots.
renderingModePolicy.bakedTextPolicy: No baked dynamic text in asset panels. Text remains code-rendered unless intentionally decorative and non-dynamic.
